nodes.label: Historical Test-after Verdict
nodes.rationale: Ten behaviors have permanent test-after evidence under the selected rubric, so the verdict remains FAIL despite all current engineering gates being green.

nodes.label: Authoritative Reviewed Inventory
nodes.rationale: The public policy omits incomplete, timing-dependent current-device inspection and presents the complete reviewed inventory instead.

nodes.label: Reviewed Prose and Registry Projection
nodes.rationale: Reviewed legal interpretation remains editorial while service and storage tables project from one typed compliance registry to prevent drift.

nodes.source_location: Build and Push Docker image to GHCR

nodes.label: Official Hosted Service Model
nodes.rationale: Clipify is open source but is currently operated through the official clipify.us deployment rather than supported as a self-hosted product.

nodes.label: Latest Production Version Support
nodes.rationale: Security updates and support apply only to the latest version deployed on Clipify's production server.

nodes.label: EU/German Single-document Baseline
nodes.rationale: One English document set matches the German operator's current scope while avoiding speculative regional variants and unsupported worldwide-compliance claims.

nodes.label: Release-controlled Policy Changes
nodes.rationale: Material changes require a policy version bump and an explicit renewed-consent or additional-notice decision.

nodes.label: Structured TypeScript Legal Content
nodes.rationale: Keeping structured content in the existing application avoids a new CMS, database, deployment, or Markdown pipeline.

nodes.label: Accessible Visual Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Hierarchy should come from surface levels, spacing, typography, and content order; interaction targets and focus states must remain accessible.

nodes.label: Tailwind Layout Rhythm
nodes.rationale: Product layouts use semantic Tailwind spacing on a consistent 4px/8px rhythm instead of copying raw values.

nodes.label: Depfu Lockfile Maintenance
nodes.source_location: Bump Bun lockfile on Depfu branches

nodes.label: Compliance Registry
nodes.rationale: Provides one reviewed declaration source for policy tables and browser-audit documentation without creating a second consent state.

nodes.label: Read-only Consent Boundary
nodes.rationale: Legal documentation may describe existing c15t activation, revocation, and cleanup behavior but must not own or modify it.

nodes.label: Value-free Audit Evidence
nodes.rationale: Browser-audit evidence records declared names, types, and origins, never storage values, while the public policy avoids runtime device inspection.

nodes.label: Authoritative Inventory Without Device Inspection
nodes.rationale: The prior runtime device inspector is superseded; the cookie policy presents the reviewed inventory without exposing a current-device snapshot.

nodes.label: Privacy Request Process
nodes.source_location: Initial channel and Supported request intentions

nodes.label: Server-rendered Legal Content
nodes.rationale: Legal content remains readable without client scripting and remains available when consent preferences cannot load.

nodes.label: Proportionate Identity Verification
nodes.rationale: Identity and authority must be sufficiently verified before disclosure or deletion, while initial requests must not solicit passwords, tokens, or full payment credentials.

nodes.label: Release-blocking Compliance Audit
nodes.source_location: Phase 5: Browser audit and release evidence

nodes.label: c15t Read-only Boundary
nodes.rationale: Legal pages read existing consent categories and open the existing preferences dialog without changing c15t state, persistence, activation, revocation, cleanup, or UI semantics.

nodes.label: Independent Legal Authorship
nodes.rationale: GoAdopt content is only a private factual checklist; public policies are independently written from verified behavior, facts, and official requirements.

nodes.label: Real-browser Compliance Audit
nodes.rationale: Browser checks complement unit tests by observing storage names, scripts, and origins across representative flows without owning consent behavior.

nodes.label: Verified Email Privacy Requests
nodes.rationale: An email route preserves accessible rights handling without prematurely introducing high-risk automated export or deletion.

nodes.label: Test-order Honesty
nodes.rationale: Green execution is retained without misrepresenting test-after scenarios as behavior-level Red evidence.
